architectSummary:
Internal REST API for submitting, approving, and reporting on employee business expenses with multi-currency support. Postgres stores all monetary values as `NUMERIC(18,4)`; FX conversion is snapshot-based and immutable at submit time. Auth uses per-employee Bearer tokens and scoped API keys (manager/admin) — no JWT, no UI.
Diagram: `docs/diagrams/generated-diagrams/expense-tracker.png`
TBD: token provisioning flow (Open Q-1); manager team-scope restriction (Open Q-4).
